title: AuthZed August 2026 Release
summary: Remove authorization bottlenecks, empower your team to innovate and expand with best-in-class performance at any scale.
body_markdown:
This release cycle is about correctness in SpiceDB, with fixes across MemDB, Postgres read replicas, and datastore readiness, plus a redaction fix in the Zed CLI and OpenFGA migration support in the` spicedb-dev` AI agent plugin.


---


### SpiceDB


#### Reliability Fixes ([v1.56.1](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.56.1) )


- **Postgres read replicas** : no more intermittent` object definition not found` errors under load. When a replica hasn't caught up, SpiceDB now reads from the primary instead.
- **MemDB consistency** : the in-memory datastore, commonly used for testing, now reliably returns your own writes when writes overlap.
- **Efficiency** : schemas with caveats use less memory, and` ReadRelationships` calls with a limit do less unnecessary work.
- **Health checks** : readiness checks now respond promptly on every datastore.


---


### Zed CLI


#### Redaction Fix ([v1.2.1](https://github.com/authzed/zed/releases/tag/v1.2.1) )


` zed backup redact` now redacts relation names used in` .any()` and` .all()` arrow expressions. Previously these were left unredacted. If you've shared redacted backups of schemas that use these operators, regenerate them with v1.2.1.


---


### Developer Tools


#### OpenFGA Migration in the` spicedb-dev` Plugin


The` spicedb-dev` plugin for AI coding agents can now help migrate an existing OpenFGA deployment onto SpiceDB. Install it from the[AuthZed marketplace](https://github.com/authzed/authzed-marketplace) .
